notes: Native T1 SHA-256 matches source; native T1/T2 stored as int16; aligned T2 float32.
T1/T2 three-plane visual contacts inspected at central brain landmarks: ventricles, callosum, thalamus and cortical outline show no gross displacement. No claim of zero local registration error.
Left and right individual reference outlines inspected in sagittal/coronal/axial contacts. Localization plausible; automatic local boundaries are not clinically approved.
Cingulate and insula folding, hippocampal/amygdala transitions, caudate tail and pallidal boundaries retain partial-volume/segmentation uncertainty.
Ventricle labels exclude separate inferior-lateral-ventricle class. Callosum labels cover central segmentation only.
Expanded label IDs 21-46 inspected bilaterally at their anchors in sagittal, coronal and axial T1 contacts. Gross localization is plausible; no specialist boundary adjudication performed.

Cortical folding, entorhinal and accumbens boundaries remain uncertain. Inferior lateral ventricles can be narrow/discontinuous; cerebellar folia have partial-volume limits. Broad frontal/parietal parcels are not functional territory maps.
Original labels 1-20 retain identical IDs, source IDs, voxel counts, bounds and anchors. Original T1 and registered T2 hashes unchanged.
Inferior lateral ventricle labels contain only 51 left / 102 right one-mm voxels; use as a limited location reference, not a complete temporal-horn extent.
